entries.question: Appointment kaise book kare
entries.answer:
KGMU mein appointment book karne ke liye aap niche diye gaye tarikon ka istemal kar sakte hain:

**1. Online Appointment (ORS Portal):**
*   Website: [www.ors.gov.in](https://www.ors.gov.in) par jayein.
*   "New Appointment" par click karein.
*   State (Uttar Pradesh) aur Hospital (KGMU) select karein.
*   Department, Date aur Time slot chunne ke baad apne patient details bharein.
*   ₹50 ka online bhugtan (payment) karein aur slip download kar lein.

**2. Mobile App:**
*   Aap **ABHA** ya **Health Care App** play store se download karke, same process follow kar sakte hain.

**3. SMS dwara:**
*   8887019134 par SMS karein: `"Appointment <Patient Name>"`

**4. Hospital mein Walk-in:**
*   Aap seedhe counter par bhi ja sakte hain. 
*   **Zaroori:** Patient ka Aadhaar card aur active mobile number saath layein. 
*   Counter par details dene ke baad mobile par OTP aayega, uske baad ₹50 ka token lekar OPD slip prapt karein.

**Zaroori Jaankari:**
*   **OPD Timing:** Somvar se Shukravar (9:00 AM – 1:00 PM) aur Shanivar (9:00 AM – 12:00 PM). Sunday ko OPD band rehti hai.
*   **Parchi Counter:** 1:00 PM par band ho jata hai, isliye samay se pahunchna behtar hai.
*   Bahari shahar ke mareezon ke liye sambandhit vibhag (department) ka valid referral hona anivarya hai.

*Disclaimer: Main qualified doctor nahi hoon. Agar aapko koi medical emergency hai, toh kripya turant KGMU ke Trauma Centre (Gate 14) jayein ya 0522-2258880 par sampark karein.*

entries.answer:

*   State mein 'Uttar Pradesh' aur Hospital mein 'KGMU' select karein.
*   'New Appointment' par click karke department, date aur time slot chunein.

**2. Mobile App:**
*   Aap **ABHA** ya **Health Care App** ko Play Store se download karke, wahan se bhi upar diye gaye process ke anusar appointment book kar sakte hain.

**3. SMS Dwara:**
*   Aap **8887019134** par *"Appointment [Patient ka Naam]"* likhkar SMS bhej sakte hain.

**4. Walk-in (Counter par):**
*   Aap seedhe KGMU OPD counter par bhi ja sakte hain.
*   **Zaroori:** Apne saath patient ka **Aadhaar Card** aur **Active Mobile Number** zaroor rakhein.
*   Counter par details dene ke baad aapke mobile par OTP aayega, jise verify karke aap ₹50 ka token aur OPD slip prapt kar sakte hain.

entries.question: Koi online number se book ho sakti hai
entries.answer:
Ji haan, aap online ya digital madhyam se appointment book kar sakte hain. Iske liye koi ek specific "online number" call karne ke bajaye, aap niche diye gaye digital tarikon ka upyog karein:

1. **SMS Dwara:** Aap **8887019134** par SMS bhej sakte hain. Format hai: **"APPOINTMENT [Patient ka Name]"**. Iske baad aapko booking ki confirmation mil jayegi.

2. **Online Portal (Sabse behtar):** Aap [www.ors.gov.in](https://www.ors.gov.in) par jakar ghar baithe appointment book kar sakte hain.

3. **Helpline Numbers:** Agar aapko booking mein koi pareshani aa rahi hai ya jaankari chahiye, toh aap in numbers par call kar sakte hain:
   *   **0522-2258880**
   *   **0522-3539333**

**Dhyan dein:** Appointment ke liye ₹50 ka shulk (fee) lagta hai. 

*Main hoon KGMU AI CHATBOT, jise Dr. Ayush Yadav ne banaya hai. Kripya dhyan rakhein ki main medical advice nahi de sakta, isliye kisi bhi bimari ya ilaaj ke liye KGMU OPD mein doctor se sampark karein. Apni niji jankari (jaise Aadhaar ya phone number) chat mein share na karein.*

entries.question: Online number pe call karne se kaise mai fees de sakta hu
entries.answer:
Call karne par aap fees ka bhugtan call ke dauran nahi kar sakte. Call sirf jaankari aur booking mein sahayata ke liye hoti hai. 

Fees jama karne ke liye aapko ye tarike apnane honge:

1. **Online Booking (ORS Portal/App):** Jab aap [www.ors.gov.in](https://www.ors.gov.in) par appointment book karte hain, toh wahan **Payment Gateway** hota hai jahan se aap UPI, Debit Card, ya Net Banking ke zariye ₹50 ka bhugtan online kar sakte hain.
2. **Counter par:** Agar aap SMS ya helpline ke zariye sirf apni slot confirm karwate hain, toh aapko hospital aakar **OPD registration counter** par hi ₹50 ka bhugtan karna hoga.

**Yaad rakhein:** KGMU mein OPD slip ki fee ₹50 hai, jo ya toh online booking ke samay ya hospital ke counter par hi jama hoti hai. Kisi bhi anjaan vyakti ya fraud number par call karke payment na karein.

*Main hoon KGMU AI CHATBOT, jise Dr. Ayush Yadav ne banaya hai. Kripya dhyan rakhein ki main medical advice nahi de sakta, isliye kisi bhi bimari ya ilaaj ke liye KGMU OPD mein doctor se sampark karein. Apni niji jankari (jaise Aadhaar ya phone number) chat mein share na karein.*

entries.question: Bhai ors portal per glitch aa rha
entries.answer:
Agar ORS portal par takneeki samasya (glitch) aa rahi hai, toh aap niche diye gaye vikalpon ka prayog kar sakte hain:

1. **SMS dwara booking:** Aap **8887019134** par **"APPOINTMENT [Patient Name]"** likhkar SMS bhejein. Yeh portal ka ek behtar vikalp hai.
2. **Helpline par call karein:** Aap **0522-2258880** ya **0522-3539333** par call karke appointment book karne ka prayas karein.
3. **Walk-in (On-site) Registration:** Agar online booking mein samasya aa rahi hai, toh aap seedhe KGMU OPD counter par bhi ja sakte hain. 
   - **Zaroori:** Apne saath **Aadhaar card** aur **active mobile number** zaroor rakhein (OTP verification ke liye).
   - **Samay:** OPD counter subah 9:00 baje se 1:00 baje tak khule rehte hain (Somwar se Shukrawar). 
   - **Salah:** Bheed se bachne ke liye jitna jaldi ho sake (subah jaldi) counter par pahunchein.

**Ek zaroori baat:** Main ek AI assistant hoon aur medical advice nahi de sakta. Kripya apni sehat ke liye doctor se sampark karein aur apni suraksha ke liye is chat mein koi bhi personal details (jaise Aadhaar number, phone number, ya medical records) share na karein.

Main KGMU AI Chatbot hoon, jise Dr. Ayush Yadav (MBBS) ne banaya hai.

entries.question: Appointment OPD
entries.answer:
To book an OPD appointment at KGMU, you can use any of the following methods:

**1. Online Portal (ORS)**
*   Visit: [www.ors.gov.in](https://www.ors.gov.in)
*   Steps: Register/Login → Select Uttar Pradesh → Select KGMU → Choose Department, Date & Time → Pay ₹50 online → Download your appointment slip.

**2. Mobile App**
*   Download the **ABHA** or **Health Care** app from the KGMU Play Store.
*   Register with your mobile number and follow the same steps as the ORS portal.

**3. SMS Booking**
*   Send an SMS in the format: **"APPOINTMENT <NAME>"** to **8887019134**.
*   You will receive a booking confirmation.

**4. Walk-in (On-Site Registration)**
*   **Requirements:** You must carry the patient's **Aadhaar Card** and an active mobile number.
*   **Process:** Visit the registration counter at the hospital, provide your details, verify via OTP, and pay the ₹50 fee to receive your physical OPD slip.
*   **Note:** Counters close at **1:00 PM** (Mon–Fri) and **12:00 PM** (Sat). Arriving early is strongly recommended as slots fill up quickly.

**Important Reminders:**
*   **Fees:** There is a flat fee of ₹50 for the OPD slip.
*   **Outside-city patients:** If you are coming from outside Lucknow, please ensure you carry a valid referral letter for the specific department you are visiting.
*   **Emergency:** If this is an emergency, please proceed directly to the **Trauma Centre (Gate 14)**.

I'm not qualified to provide medical advice. Please consult a doctor at KGMU OPD or call the helpdesk at 0522-2258880 / 0522-3539333. Also, please avoid sharing personal health details, Aadhaar numbers, or phone numbers in this chat for your safety.

entries.question: Mujhey ye pata karna hai ki vo doctor kis kis din baithte hai aur unki Timing kya hai
entries.answer:
OPD mein doctors ke baithne ka samay aur din department ke anusar alag-alag hote hain. KGMU mein OPD ka samay aamtaur par is prakar hai:

*   **Somvar se Shukravar (Mon–Fri):** Subah 9:00 AM se 1:00 PM tak.
*   **Shanivar (Sat):** Subah 9:00 AM se 12:00 PM tak.
*   **Ravivar (Sun):** OPD band rehti hai.

**Doctor ke baithne ki sahi jaankari ke liye:**
1.  **Department ka naam batayein:** Aap kis vishisht department (jaise Cardiology, Orthopedics, Pediatrics, etc.) ke bare mein puch rahe hain?
2.  **Room Number:** Bahut se departments ke liye OPD schedule (Room No. aur din) upar diye gaye "Department Information" section mein upalabdh hai.
3.  **Online Booking:** OPD mein dikhane ke liye **online registration mandatory hai**. Aap [www.ors.gov.in](https://www.ors.gov.in) par jakar apne department aur doctor ki uplabdhata (availability) check kar sakte hain.

**Mahatvapurn Suchna:**
*   **Parchi (Ticket) Counter:** OPD ki parchi subah 1:00 baje (Shanivar ko 12:00 baje) band ho jati hai, isliye samay se pahunchna anivarya hai.
*   **Medical Advice:** Main ek AI assistant hoon aur medical advice nahi de sakta. Kripya kisi bhi bimari ke liye KGMU OPD mein jakar doctor ko dikhayein.
*   **Safety:** Apni suraksha ke liye is chat mein kabhi bhi apne personal health details, phone number ya Aadhaar number share na karein.

Aap kis department ke bare mein janna chahte hain? Main aapko uska link de sakta hoon jahan aap faculty aur timings check kar sakte hain.

entries.question: Kya kgmu se refer letter ban jata hai
entries.answer:
KGMU se refer letter banwane ke liye, aapko us department ke doctor ko dikhana hota hai jahan aap apna ilaj karwa rahe hain. Agar doctor ko lagta hai ki aapko kisi dusre hospital ya higher center mein treatment ki avashyakta hai, toh wahi ke **Departmental Office** ya **Medical Superintendent (MS) office** se referral process initiate kiya jata hai.

**Kuch zaroori baatein:**
1. **Doctor ki Salah:** Referral tabhi milta hai jab aapke ilaj kar rahe doctor ise medically necessary (zaroori) maante hain.
2. **Process:** Aap apne department ke OPD counter ya PRO office se referral letter ke liye formal application aur procedure ki jankari le sakte hain.
3. **Bahari mareez (Outside-city patients):** Yaad rakhein ki agar aap KGMU mein kisi department mein dikhane aa rahe hain aur aap bahar se hain, toh aapko apne local doctor ka referral letter lana padta hai.

Main aapko yaad dila doon ki main ek AI assistant hoon aur medical advice nahi de sakta. Kripya is bare mein adhik jankari ke liye apne department ke **PRO office** ya **Helpdesk** se sampark karein.

**Suraksha Suchna:** 
Kripya is chat mein apna Aadhaar number, phone number, ya koi bhi personal health details share na karein.

Kya aapko kisi specific department ka contact number chahiye?

entries.question: Hamen yellow fever lagwana hai kya aapke pass available hai
entries.answer:
जी हाँ, KGMU में येलो फीवर (Yellow Fever) टीकाकरण की सुविधा उपलब्ध है।

यह सुविधा **Department of Community Medicine** द्वारा प्रदान की जाती है। इसके लिए आपको निम्नलिखित बातों का ध्यान रखना होगा:

*   **दिन:** सोमवार और गुरुवार (Mon/Thu)
*   **पंजीकरण का समय:** सुबह 9:00 बजे से 10:00 बजे तक
*   **स्थान:** सामुदायिक चिकित्सा विभाग (Department of Community Medicine)

**महत्वपूर्ण निर्देश:**
*   कृपया अपने साथ अपना पासपोर्ट (Passport) और अन्य आवश्यक दस्तावेज साथ लाएं।
*   टीकाकरण के लिए समय पर पहुँचना अनिवार्य है।

अधिक जानकारी के लिए आप KGMU की वेबसाइट [www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org) पर देख सकते हैं या विभाग से संपर्क कर सकते हैं।

मैं एक एआई सहायक हूँ जिसे डॉ. आयुष यादव द्वारा बनाया गया है। यदि आपको कोई अन्य स्वास्थ्य संबंधी समस्या है, तो कृपया KGMU OPD में जाकर डॉक्टर से परामर्श लें। अपनी सुरक्षा के लिए चैट में कोई भी व्यक्तिगत स्वास्थ्य विवरण या संपर्क जानकारी साझा न करें।

entries.question: मुझे मेरी रिपोर्ट पता करना है
entries.answer:
क्षमा करें, मैं आपकी मेडिकल रिपोर्ट सीधे ऑनलाइन नहीं देख सकता। अपनी रिपोर्ट प्राप्त करने के लिए आप निम्नलिखित तरीकों का उपयोग कर सकते हैं:

1. **संबंधित विभाग में संपर्क करें:** जिस विभाग में आपने अपनी जांच करवाई थी, वहां जाकर अपनी ओपीडी पर्ची (OPD Slip) दिखाएं। वे आपको रिपोर्ट का स्टेटस बता पाएंगे।
2. **ऑनलाइन परिणाम:** यदि आपकी जांच के लिए कोई ऑनलाइन पोर्टल उपलब्ध कराया गया है, तो आप KGMU की वेबसाइट [www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org) पर 'Patient Services' या संबंधित विभाग के सेक्शन में जाकर चेक कर सकते हैं।
3. **हेल्पलाइन:** आप अधिक जानकारी के लिए KGMU हेल्पलाइन नंबर **0522-2258880** पर कॉल कर सकते हैं।

entries.question: Appointment
entries.answer:
To book an appointment at KGMU, please use one of the following methods:

**1. Online Portal (Recommended)**
*   Visit [www.ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in)
*   Select State (Uttar Pradesh) and Hospital (King George's Medical University).
*   Click 'New Appointment', choose your department, date, and time slot.
*   Enter patient details and pay the ₹50 fee online to download your appointment slip.

**2. Mobile App**
*   Download the **ABHA** or **ORS** app from the KGMU Play Store.
*   Register with your mobile number and follow the same steps as the online portal.

**3. SMS Booking**
*   Send an SMS in the format: `APPOINTMENT <Patient Name>` to **8887019134**.

**4. Walk-in (On-Site)**
*   Visit the registration counter at the hospital. 
*   **Requirements:** You must bring the patient's **Aadhaar card** and an **active mobile number** to receive an OTP. 
*   The registration fee is ₹50.
*   *Note:* OPD registration counters close at **1:00 PM** (Mon–Fri) and **12:00 PM** (Sat). Pre-booking is strongly recommended to avoid long wait times.

**Important Reminders:**
*   **Outside-city patients:** Must bring a valid referral letter for their specific department.
*   **Emergency:** If you have an emergency, please go directly to the **Trauma Centre (Gate 14)**.
*   For further assistance, you can call the KGMU helpline at **0522-2258880** or **0522-3539333**.

I'm not qualified to provide medical advice. Please consult a doctor at KGMU OPD or call the helpline. Also, please avoid sharing personal details (like Aadhaar numbers or phone numbers) in this chat for your safety.
